name: talaria-v0-1-prototype
description: Execute the Talaria v0.1 prototype plan: replay-first milestone (recorder, domain core, Textual gate, status runner) then live-gateway milestone (transport, bridges, slash, daily-driver closure).

units.label: Python scaffold and quality gates
units.prompt: U1: Create the Python scaffold and quality gates (pyproject, uv.lock, talaria package, the talaria/cli.py entry point with KTD7 flag parsing, talaria/config.py implementing KTD15's ~/.talaria precedence chain, boundary check, macOS-arm64-required CI matrix). Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U1) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Scaffold commit summary, check-command output, boundary-check red/green evidence, config precedence test results.

units.label: Python recorder and redaction boundary
units.worth_it_because: Redaction is the worst place for a re-encode bug (origin R26-R27); the port must preserve anchored-pattern semantics exactly, above mechanical-transform care.
units.prompt: U2: Re-encode the recorder and redaction boundary in Python with TS contract equivalence. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U2) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Equivalence-harness result, ported test count, outbound synthetic redaction evidence.

units.label: Domain core: normalize, state, projection, compat baseline
units.worth_it_because: Reading turnController.ts (1,092 lines) into a complete reconciliation catalogue and designing deterministic normalization is judgment work; a missed rule is a shipped Hermes-fixed defect (ADR-0003).
units.prompt: U3: Complete the reconciliation catalogue at the pin, then implement the domain core (models, decode, normalize, state, projection, compat data). Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U3) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Catalogue doc path, rule-to-test map, determinism fixture results, closed QUEUED P1.

units.label: Fallback presentation-layer assessment (PC8)
units.worth_it_because: A wrong fallback verdict leaves a failed gate with no landing spot; criteria are fixed by the plan but per-criterion judgment must be sound.
units.prompt: U4: Assess prompt_toolkit against the gate criteria to plausibility depth and close the QUEUED P0. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U4) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Assessment doc path with per-criterion verdicts; QUEUED.md closure diff.

units.label: Status-line runner (frozen v1 contract)
units.prompt: U6: Implement the status-line runner against the frozen KTD5 contract with the full failure matrix. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U6) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Failure-matrix test results, contract doc path, env-sanitization evidence.

units.label: Replay-driven Textual shell - the framework validation gate
units.worth_it_because: The gate verdict and the ADR-0002 view-model evidence are the highest-judgment calls in milestone 1; a wrong pass wastes all transport work, a wrong fail discards a good framework.
units.prompt: U5: Build the replay-driven Textual shell and run the framework validation gate against the pinned corpus and thresholds. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U5) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Gate results doc (corpus identity, measurements, verdict), Pilot suite status, ADR draft path on pass.

units.label: Live transport: attach, RPC, reconnect, live recording
units.worth_it_because: Async correlation, lost-RPC unknown-outcome semantics, and reconnect reconciliation are subtle-concurrency judgment; the credential seam is the plan's least-proven external claim.
units.prompt: U7: Implement the live transport (loopback ?token= query-parameter attach via a per-dial CredentialProvider, RPC correlation with connection-epoch qualified ids, reconnect reconciliation, LiveSource, outbound recording). Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U7) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: AE8/AE16 suite results, live smoke-attach evidence, credential-hygiene sweep result.

units.label: Blocking prompts: approval path and four bridges
units.worth_it_because: Credential-bearing responds with request-id correlation and expiry semantics are security-critical; an error here leaks a secret or answers the wrong request.
units.prompt: U8: Implement the approval path and four blocking bridges in place, with terminal-read served from the projection. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U8) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Bridge round-trip results, AE3 live-corpus sweep result, expiry/late-answer evidence.

units.label: Slash commands and paste collapse
units.worth_it_because: Six enumerated result shapes with a display-projection rule and honest degradation need careful protocol handling beyond mechanical-medium, though tests are fully specified.
units.prompt: U9: Implement gateway slash dispatch (six shapes, local-entry degradation, Talaria-local set) and paste collapse. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U9) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: AE9/AE13 results, catalogue inventory summary, live dispatch evidence.

units.label: Daily-driver closure: compat verdict, install, teardown
units.worth_it_because: The daily-driver verdict must be honest under AE7/AE10 - naming gaps and blocking ready is judgment applied to deterministic checks.
units.prompt: U10: Run the compatibility-baseline verification, clean-install job, teardown proofs, and write the daily-driver verdict. Read docs/plans/2026-08-02-talaria-v0-1-prototype-plan.md (unit U10) as your authoritative spec. Apply the plan's 'Unattended execution contract' section.
units.returns: Verdict doc path (method table, matrix, ready/not-ready), AE10 CI evidence.
